title: What would you improve about the AI-assisted pixel art in my recycling factory tycoon?
author: Proper_Influence5234
selftext:
Hey,  
I’m Paul, a solo dev working on **Recycling Factory Tycoon**, an isometric game about building and running a recycling plant.

I don’t know how to do 3D modeling, so I used AI to help create the assets. The collage shows a small sample of what’s in the game: a few machines, vehicles, and workers. The middle panel is a screenshot from the game so you can see how they look together at gameplay scale.

I’d love some honest feedback. Do the machines, vehicles, and workers feel like they belong in the same game? Is anything hard to recognize once you see it at gameplay scale? If you could change one thing about the art, what would you start with?

Thanks for taking a look!
